title: British Council
lede: Reimagining digital language learning platforms to reach millions of learners across emerging markets. Designed a global teacher collaboration platform for the British Council, with reach across India

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Reimagining digital language learning platforms to reach millions of learners across emerging markets. Designed a global teacher collaboration platform for the British Council, with reach across India and emerging markets.

sections.title: Key outcomes
sections.body:
• 3M+ active learners
  • 40% engagement uplift
  • Global teacher collaboration platform deployed across multiple countries
